body.claim: Data samples are detected by what is left outside the quotation marks, and the filter only applies to plain explanations.
body.detail: Format and geometry modules document themselves with examples of their input, and django produced 771 of them: quoted dates, times and shouted type tokens. Text outside quotes holding fewer than three letters means the comment is examples. The guard on kind is what keeps the rule safe: TODO FIX THIS is shouted and unpunctuated and would match, but it classifies as a warning and is never offered to this function. Check the invariant count across a corpus before and after changing this; on django it was 256 either way.
